name: Frome Running Festival
course: Undulating closed roads: half towards Nunney, 10K loops Berkley, 5K out-and-back; downhill town-centre finish.
transport: No designated race parking; Frome station is roughly a 20-minute walk from the showground.
facilities: Informal bag drop, toilets, water about every 5km; late entrants collect packs on the day.
rules: Road closures affect parking. Half pack collection 07:30–08:30; shorter races 08:00–09:00.
reason: The 255m half-marathon climb makes this a course for measured pacing, with a fast downhill final mile. Lack of dedicated parking needs advance planning.
